events.text: The Israeli military raids 15 cities in the occupied West Bank, arresting several Palestinians and destroying a three-storey building in Hebron.
Six people are killed and another is injured when a passenger train collides with a minibus in Jewish Autonomous Oblast, Russia.
Two people succumb to their injuries sustained the day before during a mass shooting at a Greek Orthodox Church in Karak Governorate, Jordan, bringing the toll to nine killed and 40 injured.
The Yellow vests hold a second wave of mass demonstrations across France. About 410,000 people participate and over 1,000 people are arrested.
About 110,000 protesters march in Paris, France.
Several thousand rioters in Paris attack police with projectiles, but are dispersed with tear gas and water cannons. A gendarmerie helicopter is deployed to locate remaining rioters.
Marine Le Pen holds the National Rally congress in Orléans, France. Protesters, including left-wing politicians, marched in opposition.
Anti-government protests break out in Tirana, Albania. Various government buildings are attacked.
A new wave of protests is held across Italy. Clashes are reported in Bologna and Turin.
A student protest in Barcelona, Spain, ends in riots, looting and clashes with the police.
